<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Delete data from a timeless account.</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"post"} path={"/v1/timeless-indices/{id}/delete-data"}></MethodEndpoint>



Deletes the documents of a timeless account that match a time range and the optimizers that wrote them, and returns the number of documents to be deleted. Deleted data can't be restored.

* `optimizerIds` is required. Send the IDs of the optimizers whose data to delete, or an empty list to delete the data of every optimizer.
* Send both `timeFrameFrom` and `timeFrameTo` to delete within a time range, or leave both out to delete regardless of time. The range is inclusive and matches the `@timestamp` of each document.

Run [Preview a data deletion from a timeless account](https://api-docs.logz.io/docs/logz/preview-timeless-account-data-deletion) with the same request first to see how many documents it matches.

Only documents whose log type is the timeless account's current `logType` are deleted. This is the log type an optimizer writes with when its `output.target.timelessIndex.logType` is the timeless account's `logType`, as [Create an optimizer](https://api-docs.logz.io/docs/logz/create-optimizer) requires.

The deletion runs in the background, so the documents disappear over the next minutes, and the account's used storage goes down after that.

Must be run with an API token that has the **Admin** role. API tokens created before token roles were introduced have the same permissions as Admin.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
